name: useChannelSounding
summary: Bluetooth Core 6.0 high-accuracy centimeter-precision Phase-Based Ranging (PBR).
plain: Inspects hardware Bluetooth Low Energy 6.0 Channel Sounding transceiver state and manages high-precision spatial distance estimation. Uses multi-channel phase-based ranging (PBR) and round-trip time (RTT) across 79 Bluetooth channels without requiring line of sight.
description: Backed by android.hardware.bluetooth_le.channel_sounding and the Android 16/17 Ranging HAL service (IBluetoothChannelSounding). Measures distance with sub-decimeter accuracy, complementing UWB for non-line-of-sight spatial positioning. Nothing is simulated: queries actual device hardware capabilities.

returns.name: isSupported
returns.desc: Whether the hardware physically supports BLE 6.0 Channel Sounding.

returns.name: isEnabled
returns.desc: Whether Channel Sounding is enabled (requires Bluetooth enabled and hardware support).

returns.name: serviceFound
returns.desc: Whether the underlying Android Ranging HAL service is active on device.

returns.name: supportsRtt
returns.desc: Whether Round-Trip Time (RTT) ranging is supported.

returns.name: channelCount
returns.desc: Number of BLE channels utilized (79 on Bluetooth 6.0).

returns.name: isRanging
returns.desc: Whether an active ranging session is currently underway.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Latest error message if operation failed.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: Telemetry provenance: 'hardware' when read from physical device.

returns.name: startRanging
returns.desc: Starts a Channel Sounding ranging session against paired or discovered BLE devices.

actions.name: startRanging(targetAddress?)
actions.desc: Starts a Channel Sounding ranging session against paired or discovered BLE devices.
